description: The Mendeley release contains quality-controlled observations from a Marine Automatic Weather Station at Cirebon Jetty in the Pelindo port area of Indonesia. Its public CSV has 3,298,281 rows from 1 October 2025 to 4 May 2026, recording corrected water level, air temperature, relative humidity, pressure, wind speed and wind direction at a dominant five-second interval. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0. The producer explains that ultrasonic water-level distances were transformed against an installation reference; the released values are not an independently surveyed national tidal datum. Sensor calibration, variable-specific quality flags and a seven-month window are limitations for estimating long-run extremes or port downtime. A reviewer-assessed use is checking coastal forcing and short-term port exposure in maritime infrastructure simulations. data-denmark-kystdata-coastal-measurements is a related coastal observation source but has different instrumentation and geography. Round-one article candidates were excluded from wastewater and telecom sweeps; this port and coastal use is in scope. No CSV was downloaded.
